attributes.action: Require an ingredient risk-rating score on food and beauty product labels
attributes.additional_details: Nutri-Score, already adopted in seven European countries, and apps like Yuka provide detailed information on the risk of additives in products, as well as their nutritional balance. Scores are generated according to the latest data from the European Food Safety Authority, the WHO's International Agency for Research on Cancer, and independent scientific research studies. Such scores will encourage consumers to make healthier choices, and producers to improve the quality of products sold.
attributes.background: Require food, drink, beauty and cosmetic products sold in the UK to display an ingredient risk-rating score on packaging, such as Nutri-Score or Yuka score, which evaluates ingredient risk based on data from independent scientific research studies.

rejection.details: We are not clear what risk factors you are referring to. You could start a new petition setting out more clearly which risks you would like to see included in such a score.
